chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him), when his companions showed impatience at his delaying permission for them to fight in Siffin,

key_terms.اسْتَبْطَأَ: he showed impatience / felt the delay was long
key_terms.بِصِفِّينَ: in Siffin (the location of the battle)

ai.seo_question: What was the context of Imam Ali's speech when his men were impatient to fight at Siffin?
ai.summary: This passage captures the psychological tension during the Battle of Siffin, where Imam Ali (peace be upon him) exercised strategic patience (hilm) to ensure political legitimacy and avoid premature conflict, despite his troops' eagerness for decisive action. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing military readiness with diplomatic prudence, illustrating how Ali’s leadership prioritized justice and calculated timing over mere martial enthusiasm.
